meta.originalInput: Every time you tolerate disrespect, broken promises, or your own excuses, your brain logs it as acceptable. Neuroplasticity does not judge morality; it optimizes for repetition. When you silence your instinct to keep the peace, neural pathways adapt downward. Your threshold drops, anxiety numbs, and chaos becomes your new baseline standard. Stop waiting for motivation to draw boundaries. Define one non-negotiable standard today. The moment you push back against what drains you, your brain rewires your self-worth.
meta.topic: Your Brain Learns What You Repeatedly Tolerate
